Original supporting pages, kept separate from the movies. Historical stats are snapshots from the artwork. Only completed recap pages are shown; blank templates stay in the source files.

How to use this collection

Choose a collection, then change the order: timeline, rating, genre, or A–Z. Timeline opens newest first; select it again to reverse the source sequence. Cards load in batches as you scroll, with Show more available too. Search by movie or card-note phrase. Filter 🧠, ❤️, or 🌊 independently. Click any image for the full-resolution portrait card.

Collections follow the Canva export names, not release years. The 2025 file starts in December 2024 and includes some entries also in the 2026 file. Shared films appear once in the complete collection. Timeline follows the source sequence; precise viewing dates will be added only when confirmed.

Colors: newer confirmed cards use the documented genre-color palette. Older card colors are archival, not proof of genre. Plausible older browsing fits remain provisional and are labeled in their details; clear mismatches and uncertain assignments are Unmapped. Original backgrounds and line colors are preserved.

Coming next: Instagram reviews, confirmed older genre assignments, and completion of unfinished cards. Missing scores stay blank and are excluded from minimum-rating filters. All scores here use a five-point scale; a printed 8/10 is shown as 4/5.
